YOU HAVE PROVED YOURSELF QUITE SKILLFUL SO FAR...
BUT HOW SKILLFUL DO YOU THINK YOU ACTUALLY ARE?|'''???''' on Wave 41 of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode ([[Hidden Wave]])}} }} ==Description== '''???''', internally referred to as '''Unknown''', is the main narrator of the [[Hidden Wave]]. While its identity is not revealed in-game, it did appear in [[Failed Gateway]] on the other side of the portal, sitting on a throne in the [[Nil Zone]]. The exact character model was also called [[Lord Exo]] by the [[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] in the [[Lunar Overture Event]]'s scrapped final map cutscenes and in [[The Classic Event]]'s trailer. Multiple maps also use the same appearance, such as a sign in [[Pier Pressure]]. ==Appearance== '''???''' has a completely black body. Its torso is translucent, revealing its ribcage. It wears a black domino crown. While not that clear from just the [[Hidden Wave]], '''???''' is actually a silhouette, as the original character actually has a purple torso. ==Trivia== *The '''???''' narrator uses a similar model as the [[1x1x1x1]] from [[The Classic Event]], except that it has a completely black body and a different ribcage. **However, these two narrators are not the same character. Rather, '''???''' is assumed to be [[Lord Exo]] due to its similar characteristics with one of [[Lord Exo|Lord Exo's]] appearances (the model shown in [[Failed Gateway]]), though this is not entirely confirmed. *Unlike other narrators, '''???''' refers to the player as just ''"player"''. **While other characters do talk to the player or even mention in-game mechanics, they treat the player as a member of the [[T.D.S. Organization]] in most cases, with some exceptions like the [[Refund Center]]. ==Update History== *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **'''???''' added. {{NarratorNavBox}}
